title: Reassign and Unassign work from the keyboard through the More actions menu
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ben" are active at this location, and both are pinned in your Board View (no other technician is pinned).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Reassign" has three Approved work orders: unit "C368152-U1" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ana", unit "C368152-U3" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ben", and unit "C368152-U4" with no lead technician. None has a shift on the Schedule.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Reassign", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until a card shows a focus ring.
  3. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C368152-U1".
  4. Press Tab.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Choose "Reassign lead technician" with the arrow keys and press Enter.
  7. Type "C368152 Ben" in the dialog's search box.
  8. Choose "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ben" with the arrow keys and press Enter.
  9. Use the arrow keys to move the focus ring to the card for unit "C368152-U3".
  10. Press Tab.
  11. Press Enter.
  12. Choose "Unassign" with the arrow keys and press Enter.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box.

Step 2: a card shows the focus ring.

Step 3: the card for unit "C368152-U1" shows the focus ring.

Step 4: the card's "More actions" (…) button shows and has the focus.

Step 5: the menu opens and offers "Reassign lead technician" and "Unassign".

Step 6: the "Reassign lead technician" dialog opens.

Step 7: the dialog's list narrows to "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ben".

Step 8: unit "C368152-U1" moves to "ZZAUTOTEST C368152 Ben"'s column and "Lead technician updated" shows.

Step 9: the card for unit "C368152-U3" shows the focus ring.

Step 10: the card's "More actions" (…) button has the focus.

Step 11: the menu opens.

Step 12: unit "C368152-U3" moves to the "Unassigned" column and "Lead technician removed" shows.
